purpose: Local-motion ROI verification candidate: keep the coarse async cooldown path but lower the motion trigger threshold so a small moving object can enter the ROI refresh path.
expected_effect: Trigger refresh on local object motion that is too small for candidate_0030's 40% pan threshold.
Produce positive color_refresh_roi_count with ROI area below the full-frame rejection cap.
Separate ROI plumbing validation from the slow-pan benchmark.
risk: The 3% motion threshold is for deterministic ROI validation only; it is not suitable for live slow-pan best and may over-refresh on noise or minor camera motion.
